reason: Most of my jobs are brand warranty work, and the brand already makes my boys log those in its own system, so this would only help with my own customers' jobs. Paying ₹199 a head for every technician when other job apps cost about ₹99, just to cover half the work, does not add up for me.
objection: My technicians would end up reporting the same job twice, once in the brand's app and once in yours, and they will grumble and skip one. Then I am paying double what other apps charge for something half-used.
would_change_my_mind: If it could push the job details into the brand's system for me, or at least fill both from the one voice note, so my technicians report each job only once.
